blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives has approved on final reading a measure seeking to renew for another 50 years the franchise granted to Cebu Air Inc., operating as Cebu Pacific. During Monday’s session, 289 lawmakers voted to pass House Bill No. 11536, with no votes in the negative and no abstentions. READ: Cebu Pacific announces flight cancellations amid Middle East unrest Under the bill, Cebu Air will receive a new 50-year term after its franchise under Republic Act (RA) No. 7151 expires.
